summary: Frontend-only verification of header logo enlargement bug fix and related regressions on TS Unique Laundry. Navbar brand-logo image renders at 64x64 (h-16, w-16) both at top-of-page (transparent nav) and after scroll (glass nav), with correct alt text 'TS Unique Laundry logo' and gold ring styling. Home page loads with hero H1, trust badges, featured services and footer. Theme toggle flips dark<->light without breaking logo. Nav links for services and pricing route correctly. Mock login (naledi@example.co.za / password123) redirects to /dashboard where the sidebar logo renders at 44x44 (size='md') on desktop and the mobile top bar logo also renders at 44x44.

issues: The dashboard mobile top bar brand-logo appears partially clipped at the top-left corner (x=16, y=12, 44x44) while the horizontal tab bar (Overview / Laundry History / ...) overlaps the same region. Not part of this bug scope but worth revisiting for polish.

critical_code_review_comments: Logo.jsx: data-testid='brand-logo' is on the wrapping <Link>. Two brand-logo elements are rendered on the home page (navbar + footer). Tests must scope by parent (main-navbar/main-footer). Consider distinct testids like 'navbar-brand-logo' and 'footer-brand-logo' for easier targeting.
Navbar renders <Logo size='lg'> (64px) which matches the fix. Verified via bounding_box height=64 in both scrolled and unscrolled states.
test_credentials: Customer mock login: any email + any 6+ char password (used naledi@example.co.za / password123). Admin view: admin@ts.co.za.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home page has TWO brand-logo test-ids (navbar + footer). Always scope with [data-testid='main-navbar'] [data-testid='brand-logo'] or [data-testid='main-footer'] [data-testid='brand-logo']. Login form uses data-testid='login-email' (type=text), 'login-password', 'login-submit' — NOT 'login-email-input'. Dashboard sidebar uses size='md' logo (44px) intentionally; only marketing Navbar uses size='lg' (64px).
rca of the issue: Bug was that Navbar Logo used the default size='md' (h-11 = 44px), making the emblem feel like a small icon. Fix: Logo.jsx added SIZES.lg (h-16 w-16 = 64px) plus larger wordmark and gold ring; Navbar.jsx passes size='lg'. Verified rendered box.height === 64 in both transparent and glass-nav states — bug is resolved.
